title: 8 Ways a Godly Man's Feed Lies About Him
caption:
Nothing on your feed has to be fake for it to lie about you.

The verse, the gym photo, the church selfie can all be true and still tell a story that isn't. A godly man is the same guy online, offline, and at 1 a.m. That's not a posting strategy. It's what happens when the hidden stuff gets dealt with.

Which one hit closest? Save this and be honest with yourself.

#faith #godlyman #integrity #socialmedia
